name: The Old Soldier
summary: An old soldier, read correctly: infantry, India long ago, the left thigh healed short. Holmes added that he waits for a grandchild.

name: The Old Soldier
summary: I misread him. Holmes put me right: an old soldier, infantry, India long ago, the left thigh healed short.

name: The Actor
summary: Not a curate: an actor between performances. I named him before Holmes said a word.

name: The Actor
summary: Not a curate: an actor between performances. I saw a black coat and stopped looking; Holmes put the glass in my hand.

name: What Asks to Be Seen
summary: Holmes, at the window: we see what asks to be seen. I could not describe one other person who had passed.
